releaseNotes: v1.6.0 is a major UI refresh with phone-friendly pages, a Needs attention list, and one-stop Device and Bulk actions. Fixes device snoozes that never stuck, notification devices ignoring the notifications switch, Send Now reporting sent when nothing went out, and the portal's last scan time. If summaries stop arriving, check that Notifications is On.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Device Health Monitor
apps.description: Learns each device's normal check-in pattern and flags devices that go quiet, with verification, locations, snooze, and a live web portal.
